<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':53,'col':22}])
fr=current_frame
def cen(col,rmin=0,rmax=64):
    ps=[(i,j) for i,line in enumerate(fr.ascii.split('\n')) for j,ch in enumerate(line) if ch==col and j>5 and rmin<=i<rmax]
    return (round(sum(r for r,c2 in ps)/len(ps)),round(sum(c2 for r,c2 in ps)/len(ps)),len(ps)) if ps else None
print('ball W',cen('W'),'G',cen('G'),'p>40',cen('p',40),'p<40',cen('p',0,40))
t=transitions[-1]
a=t.before_frame.ascii.split('\n'); b=t.after_frame.ascii.split('\n')
diff=[(i,j,a[i][j],b[i][j]) for i in range(len(a)) for j in range(min(len(a[i]),len(b[i]))) if a[i][j]!=b[i][j]]
rs=[d[0] for d in diff]; cs=[d[1] for d in diff]
print('diff n',len(diff),'rows',(min(rs),max(rs)) if rs else None,'cols',(min(cs),max(cs)) if cs else None)
print('res',last_action_result.get('board_changed'),last_action_result.get('level_completed'),last_action_result.get('done'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
